defects.symptom: Fifth workbook stays 正在读取工作簿… after openOffice TOO_LARGE; no visible retry
defects.cause: Successful unchanged-file refresh cleared model-open failure
defects.fix: Preserve Office open error separately; successful metadata refresh restores it, explicit successful reload clears it.
defects.tests: buffer failure/stat failure/recovery + React error/reload flow, both passed

defects.symptom: B2=2, B3=4; Up then F2 from B3 displayed 编辑 B2 with value 4. Escape cancelled and B2 remained 2.
defects.fix: Bind selected-cell text to client/sheet/row/column/model version; F2 fetches target text while formula-bar read is pending; inline input must match exact row/column.

tests.negativeResult: 1 expected failure: F2 ignored while target read delayed, 24 not selected

defects.retest: ui-r3: from B3=4 press Up then F2 -> 编辑 B2 value 2; enter 12, Enter -> B2=12 and B3=4; repeat Up/F2 -> 编辑 B2 value 12; Escape preserves 12. Saved/restarted validation and threshold also present.

defects.symptom: Typing red channel 180 in native color picker committed after first digit, closed popup and saved #010000 instead of #b40000.
defects.fix: Keep intermediate input local; commit on native change or blur, deduplicate normalized colors; preserve standard inspector save blur.
